contract_metadata.contract_name: KX134 dual sensor transport contract v3
contract_metadata.notes: Documentation-only contract. It defines the future KX134 data shape and does not implement firmware, GUI, CSV export, packaging, or calibration.

supported_topologies.name: two_sensor_nodes_plus_receiver
supported_topologies.description: Two ESP32 sensor nodes, each connected to one KX134, send packets by ESP-NOW to one ESP32 receiver that outputs USB Serial to the PC application.

rejected_or_deferred_topologies.name: alternative_two_esp32_topology_pending
rejected_or_deferred_topologies.reason: The user confirmed the current KX134 migration phase will use three ESP32 boards total.

rejected_or_deferred_topologies.name: single_esp32_reads_two_kx134
rejected_or_deferred_topologies.reason: The current architecture assigns one KX134 sensor to each ESP32 sensor node.

field_definitions.name: protocol_version
field_definitions.description: Protocol identifier emitted with each KX134 stream or row.

field_definitions.name: session_id
field_definitions.description: Unique capture session identifier assigned by the PC/GUI.

field_definitions.name: sensor_id
field_definitions.description: Logical sensor identifier. Valid values are 1 and 2 only.

field_definitions.name: physical_label
field_definitions.description: Visible physical label attached to the sensor assembly.

field_definitions.name: node_id
field_definitions.description: Stable logical identifier of the ESP32 node associated with the sensor.

field_definitions.name: node_mac
field_definitions.description: ESP32 MAC address associated with the KX134 sensor node.

field_definitions.name: seq
field_definitions.description: Monotonic sample sequence counter per sensor node.

field_definitions.name: sensor_t_us
field_definitions.description: Sensor node timestamp captured near sample acquisition.

field_definitions.name: receiver_t_us
field_definitions.description: Receiver timestamp captured when the packet arrives at the receiver.

field_definitions.name: pc_wall_s
field_definitions.description: PC wall-clock relative time captured when the GUI parses or writes the sample.

field_definitions.name: sync_group_id
field_definitions.description: Receiver or GUI assigned identifier used to group samples considered part of the same synchronization window.

field_definitions.name: pair_seq
field_definitions.description: Receiver or GUI assigned paired-sample sequence for dual-sensor alignment.

field_definitions.name: x_raw
field_definitions.description: Raw KX134 X-axis digital output. It must not be filtered or replaced.

field_definitions.name: y_raw
field_definitions.description: Raw KX134 Y-axis digital output. It must not be filtered or replaced.

field_definitions.name: z_raw
field_definitions.description: Raw KX134 Z-axis digital output. It must not be filtered or replaced.

field_definitions.name: x_g
field_definitions.description: Basic X-axis acceleration conversion in g.

field_definitions.name: y_g
field_definitions.description: Basic Y-axis acceleration conversion in g.

field_definitions.name: z_g
field_definitions.description: Basic Z-axis acceleration conversion in g.

field_definitions.name: sample_rate_hz
field_definitions.description: Requested or configured sample rate reported for this sample.

field_definitions.name: odr_hz
field_definitions.description: KX134 output data rate configured in the sensor.

field_definitions.name: range_g
field_definitions.description: KX134 measurement range used for raw-to-g conversion.

field_definitions.name: calibration_id
field_definitions.description: Identifier of the per-sensor calibration record used for conversion.

field_definitions.name: calibration_applied
field_definitions.description: True when valid calibration coefficients were applied to x_g, y_g, and z_g.

field_definitions.name: packet_status
field_definitions.description: Validation status assigned to the packet or CSV row.

field_definitions.name: packet_error_code
field_definitions.description: Diagnostic code preserved when packet_status is not OK.

field_definitions.name: firmware_version
field_definitions.description: Firmware version emitted by the sensor node.

field_definitions.name: contract_version
field_definitions.description: Contract version asserted by the sender for this row.

validation_rules: receiver_t_us is required for streams received through a receiver.
x_raw, y_raw, and z_raw are required.
x_g, y_g, and z_g are required in final export.
sample_rate_hz must be one of 100, 200, 400, or 800.
range_g must be one of 8, 16, 32, or 64.
A line without sensor_id must be marked invalid.
KX134 streams with ADXL335 columns must not be accepted as valid KX134 data.
Raw data must not be discarded or replaced.
If packet_error_code exists, it must be preserved in export.
pc_wall_s must not be used as the only synchronization source.

notes: The formula must be confirmed against the KX134 library used in firmware.
The conversion does not replace raw data.
If valid calibration is missing, calibration_id must indicate an uncalibrated state and packet_status must reflect it when applicable.

synchronization.pair_seq_description: pair_seq is a future receiver or GUI sequence used to associate samples from sensor_id 1 and sensor_id 2 within a synchronization window.
synchronization.sync_group_id_description: sync_group_id identifies the capture or synchronization group used to compare or pair samples across both sensors.
